source.title: Hinterlands Mission I: Defeat Moonkin
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Defeat moonkin there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat 20 Fallen Moonkin in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
